# PowerPoint conversion regression corpus

Only owned or explicitly redistributable presentations belong here. Never add
customer decks, private workshop results, participant identities or credentials.

- `keynope/`: deterministic synthetic presentations generated by Keynope tests.
- `expected/`: supported semantic expectations and known conversion warnings.
- Future `imported/` fixtures must include source, author, license and any
  redistribution restrictions beside the file.
- Visual baselines should name the renderer/version, viewport, expected tolerance
  and feature coverage. A package parse is not a visual rendering check.

## Entrance timing fixture

`keynope/timing-native.pptx` is entirely synthetic. It contains one hidden slide,
five rectangular objects, a native Push transition and four native entrance
steps (initial automatic Appear, grouped click Fade, automatic Wipe and Zoom).
No external media, fonts, notes, activities, macros or external relationships.

The fixture was generated with `TestTimelineNativeXMLRoundTripAndShapeIDs` in
`internal/pptx/timing_test.go`. It is authored by this project and distributed
under the repository license. Numeric target IDs and expected triggers are
specified in `expected/timing-native.json`. The static fixture protects reader
compatibility independently of changes to the current writer.

Regenerate intentionally after reviewing changes:

```
KEYNOPE_PPTX_TIMING_EVIDENCE="$PWD/testdata/pptx/keynope" go test -count=1 -run '^TestTimelineNativeXMLRoundTripAndShapeIDs$' ./internal/pptx
go test -run TestTimelineCorpus ./internal/pptx
```

Core slide and presentation XML was checked against official ECMA-376
transitional schemas; ignorable PowerPoint 2010 duration metadata was checked
separately. Real PowerPoint animation playback has not been recorded. Office
is neither a runtime nor an automated-test dependency.
